content.content: The seam moves working-copy edits into an older change via `jj squash --into <id>`, taking the working copy as the source.
content.rationale: D6 places each edit into its owning change; squash --into is the verb whose documented role is moving working-copy changes into another revision, and the emptied source is abandoned, preserving one-change-one-node. The move spelling names no verb this jj supplies.
